QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] Seeking Lost Memories
QuestInfo.0:
The Memory Keeper says you need to go back to where your adventure first started in order to recover your lost memories...
That must be when your #bdad#k gave you the Chakram.
You should probably pay the Erimos Weapon Store a long-overdue visit.
QuestInfo.1:
You recalled when you started your adventure in Erimos.
Dad, Jad, Tasha, and your one and only younger sister, Rasha...
You will never give up on the people you love.
